argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$b='http://127.0.0.1:17448'
$health=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($b+'/api/health') -TimeoutSec 3
$control=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($b+'/api/supervisor-watchdog?detect=0') -TimeoutSec 3
$chats=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($b+'/api/supervisor-watchdog/managed-chats?inspect=0') -TimeoutSec 3
$tasks=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($b+'/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments') -TimeoutSec 3
Write-Output ('BRIDGE_HEALTH='+$health.state)
Write-Output ('BRIDGE_HEALTH_REASON_COUNT='+@($health.reasons).Count)
Write-Output ('MANAGED_TOTAL='+@($chats.chats).Count)
foreach($role in @('qa','bridge','media','creator','growth','native-mcp','owner-curator')){
 $targets=@($chats.chats|Where-Object {$_.role -eq $role -and $_.enabled -ne $false})
 Write-Output ('ROLE_'+$role+'_COUNT='+$targets.Count)
 if($targets.Count -eq 1){
  $z=$targets[0]
  Write-Output ('ROLE_'+$role+'_CHAT_ID_PRESENT='+[bool]$z.id)
  Write-Output ('ROLE_'+$role+'_REPOSITORY='+[string]$z.repository)
  Write-Output ('ROLE_'+$role+'_BRANCH='+[string]$z.branch)
 }
}
Write-Output ('ACTIVE_ASSIGNMENTS='+@($tasks.assignments|Where-Object {$_.state -in @('queued','dispatching','running','awaiting_evidence','unknown')}).Count)
Write-Output ('AUTO_CONTINUE='+$control.config.autoContinueEnabled)
Write-Output ('MAX_PARALLEL='+$control.config.maxParallelAgents)
Write-Output ('R45_RUNNER_PID_COUNT='+@((Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'")|Where-Object {$_.CommandLine -match 'autonomy-r45-runner\.js'}).Count)

note: Read-only live R45 planner health, managed role binding presence and unsettled queue audit; no chat URLs, IDs or private credentials printed.
